Наш словарь рифм поможет вам быстро подобрать нужную рифму, придаст блеск и законченность вашим стихотворениям. Этот простой и удобный инструмент в связке с Викисловарем и Википедией раскрепостит вашу творческую мысль. Сочиняйте стихи с комфортом. И никакой рекламы!

Our rhyming dictionary helps you quickly find the right rhyme, will add brilliance and perfection to your poems. This simple and convenient tool  in conjunction with Wiktionary and Wikipedia will free up your creativity. Write poetry with comfort and ease. And no any ads!

ATTENTION! Internet connection is required with no subscription to Offline mode. 

RUSSIAN RHYMING DICTIONARY

  •  High-quality and extensive lexical base — 100 thousand words, 2.1 million word forms. 
  •  Voice input for iOS 10+ (works without the Internet on iOS 13).  
  •  Effective phonetic matching algorithm taking into account stress and other pronunciation features of words. 
  •  Search history and Favorites: you can mark your favorite rhymes. Also you can sync History between all your iOS devices via iCloud (when subscribing to Offline mode).
  •  The filter of results by quality rhyme, part of speech, lexical frequency, a number​ of syllables. 
  •  Comfortable working with the clipboard. When switching from another application rhymes for the word from the clipboard are automatically found. Results are also automatically copied to the clipboard. 

POEM OF THE DAY

An anthology of Russian poetry structured on the calendar principle. 
Editors: Maria Falikman and Nikolay Ketsaris.

  •  Offline access to all poems — read the anthology at any convenient time. The Internet is only needed for downloading new poems.
  •  Push-notifications about today verses.
  •  Smart search for poets and poems.
  •  Favorites — mark favorite poems for repeated reading and read poems that others liked.
  •  Audio — the authors read their poems.

RUSSIAN WIKTIONARY

  •  'Clear' articles: compact and full view, semantic coloring. The structure of articles is improved.
  •  Selection of vocabulary zones for viewing (word forms, synonyms, examples, phrases, etc.).
  •  Popup mini-articles for words and phrases from the article. Tap on the mini-article to open a new full article.
  •  Brief encyclopedic information from Wikipedia with pictures.

  •  Smart phrases search and correction of the mistakes. Obscene and foreign-language articles are filtered.
  •  Articles previously viewed are available offline. 
  •  Simple navigation using one hand.
  •  Use with other applications: the word from the clipboard, Slide Over и Split View mode for iPad.

SUBSCRIPTION TO OFFLINE MODE

To use the dictionaries in the absence of internet connection, you can subscribe to the OFFLINE mode. It is an auto-renewable subscription on 2 months or 1 year. The downloadable Rhyming Dictionary is significantly more complete and contains almost 2 times more words than its online version. The offline Wiktionary contains 450,000 words and phrases. There is a free trial period (1 month). Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

Please note: the subscription is automatically renewed at the end of the current period unless you choose to cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription from your Account Settings after purchase. You cannot cancel the subscription on the current active period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription, where applicable.

Terms of Use: https://rifmovnik.ru/ios/rhymes/subscription
Privacy Policy: https://rifmovnik.ru/ios/privacy
